verses.1: Therefore, nothing should be questioned now about those who are in Christ Jesus.
verses.2: For the law of the Spirit of life has been freed for you through Jesus Christ, from the law of sin and death.
verses.3: For it was impossible according to the law, in which sin had caused one to be weakened. Therefore, God sent His own Son into the world, so that through His flesh, sin could be judged and punished.
verses.4: So that the rights granted by law can be fulfilled for those who do not move physically, but rather through their spirit.
verses.5: For those who are physical in nature, they care about things related to the physical world. Those who are spiritual in nature, on the other hand, care about things related to the spiritual world.
verses.6: For the care of the body is death; but the care of the soul is life and peace.
verses.7: For the care of the flesh is hostile towards God. In fact, according to God’s law, it cannot be controlled or subdued at all.
verses.8: But those who are truly divine in nature cannot please God.
verses.9: We, however, are not in our flesh, but in the spirit. For it is the spirit of God that dwells within us. But if someone does not have the spirit of Christ, then he does not belong to Him at all.
verses.10: And if Christ is in you, then the body is dead through sin, but the Spirit gives life through righteousness.
verses.11: And if the spirit of the resurrected Jesus is in you, then the resurrected Christ, Jesus, will give life to your dead bodies, through the spirit that he has within you.
verses.12: Therefore, brothers, they still deserve punishment; they do not live according to the laws of the flesh.
verses.13: For if you were to live according to the flesh, then you would die. But if you were to carry out the actions of the body through the spirit, then you would live.
verses.14: For those who are led by the spirit of God, they are indeed sons of God.
verses.15: For you are no longer taking on the spirit of servitude into fear, but rather the spirit of devotion, in which we cry out: “Abba, Father!”
verses.16: That spirit attests to our own spirit that we are indeed children of God.
verses.17: And if they are children, then they have heirs as well. The heirs are those of God, while the heirs of Christ are those who share in His inheritance. This is so that we may also be blessed and exalted together with them.
verses.18: I believe that the sufferings of this present time should not be revealed to us in relation to the future glory.
verses.19: For the disbelief regarding the construction of this structure is related to the revelation of the sons of God.
verses.20: For its mediocrity, the construction failed to succeed. It didn’t even start at all; it was completed only because of those who took control of it. In hope…
verses.21: For also this construction will be freed from the slavery of greed, and will become a means of achieving freedom in the glory of God’s children.
verses.22: We know, after all, that all construction and building work has been done in a way that is wasteful and inefficient, right up to the present day.
verses.23: Not only that, but they also possess the very origin of the spirit. They also delve deeply within themselves, accepting the purification of our bodies.
verses.24: For we have been saved by hope. But hope is not really a hope at all, for who can truly say that they are hoping when they see what they actually have?
verses.25: But if we do not see it, then we must endure patiently.
verses.26: In the same way, our weak bodies also encounter this “spirit”. We don’t know what to pray for, but that spirit comes upon us in the form of bitter, stinging sensations.
verses.27: But he who understood the hearts of people knew what the care of the spirit meant: that it happens through God for the sake of the holy ones.
verses.28: We know that those who love the God will cooperate with Him in all things for good. They are those who are called according to their purpose.
verses.29: Because he who was chosen and promoted those who were like the image of his Son, so that they could be first among many brothers.
verses.30: And as he promoted them, he also called them by their names. And as he called them by their names, he also honored them. And as he honored them, he also made them famous.
verses.31: So, what should we do in relation to this? If the God is on our side, then who else can help us?
verses.32: Whoever did not keep his own son, but gave him up for us all, how much less will he not also give us everything with him?
verses.33: Who is he calling upon as a chosen god? A god of justice.
verses.34: Who is the one who judges? It’s Christ, who died for us. He is also the one who stands on the right side of God, and it is He who intercedes for us.
verses.35: What will divide us from the love of Christ? Will it be sorrow, loneliness, persecution, isolation, danger, or violence?
verses.36: As it is written, “For this reason, we will die all day long; we will be treated like livestock for slaughter.”
verses.37: But in all these things, we will prevail, because of the one who loves us.
verses.38: For I have realized that neither death nor life, nor angels, nor ancestors, nor the future, nor powers…
verses.39: Neither height nor depth, nor any other obstacles, can separate us from the love of God, which is in Jesus Christ, our Lord.
